frames.narration: Each request updates a few counters in memory: requests_total, errors_total, and a latency histogram. This costs almost nothing.
The histogram sorts each latency into a bucket: under 50 ms, under 100 ms, under 250 ms, under 1 s, and so on. It stores only the count per bucket, not every value.
Every 15 seconds the collector scrapes the service's current numbers.
The collector writes the values to the time-series store with a timestamp and a few labels such as service and endpoint.
A dashboard asks the store for the rate of requests, the error ratio and the p50, p95 and p99 latency over the last hour.
The average says 120 ms and looks fine. The p99 says one request in a hundred takes nearly 3 seconds. The percentiles reveal the problem the average hid.
